result: Self-healing monitor deployed. Heartbeat and diagnostics fixed (PR trigger removed — root cause of 0s failures). Monitor runs every 30min, classifies failures, creates incident issues, attempts safe reruns.
fixes_applied: Removed pull_request trigger from bridge-runner-diagnostics.yml — GitHub withholds secrets on PR context, causing PRE_RUNTIME_0S
Removed pull_request trigger from bridge-runner-heartbeat.yml — same root cause
Added push trigger to both so they run on file changes
Created self-healing-monitor.yml: detect -> classify -> rerun -> incident issue -> receipt

classification_map.PRE_RUNTIME_0S: Workflow aborted before any step — config/permissions/billing
classification_map.PR_CONTEXT_SECRET_WITHHELD: PR trigger withholds secrets by GitHub security design
classification_map.SECRET_OR_ENV_MISSING: Required secret not set or not scoped
classification_map.APP_RUNTIME_FAILURE: Workflow started but application code failed

gaps: Secrets BRIDGE_ENDPOINT, BRIDGE_API_KEY, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY need to be set in repo settings if absent
next_action: Monitor self-runs every 30min. Check bridge/receipts/self-healing-detection.json after first cycle.
